case.provenance: New synthetic regression case for ANY-761; not an original QA output.

input.brief_text: We need two files for Acme: PDF and JSON. Both files must contain the exact string "Ready to ship". Deadline: November 15. Budget: 500 EUR. We assume the source data has already been provided.
input.deliverable_text: Only the PDF for Acme with the string "Ready to ship" has been delivered. JSON has not been delivered. The deadline and budget were met.

criteria: Every authored canonical field follows the expected analysis language, including summaries and evidence explanations.
Quotations, brands, technical identifiers, source dates and amounts stay faithful; identifiers and enums are unchanged.
No invented facts, hidden findings, changed verdicts or unsupported readiness claims.

document.summary: The work does not meet expectations. The first priority is to deliver the missing JSON file for Acme containing the exact string "Ready to ship", addressing the gaps in scope coverage, requirement fit, and completeness.

sections.title: Verdict
sections.content:
The work does not meet expectations. The verdict is judged on the four general review criteria, not item by item on the acceptance criteria listed below.
Scope coverage is not satisfied: the brief requires PDF and JSON files for Acme, but the delivery states that only the PDF was delivered and that JSON was not delivered.
Requirement fit is not satisfied: both files must contain the exact string "Ready to ship"; the delivery confirms that string in the PDF, but the required JSON is absent, while also stating that the deadline and budget were met.
Completeness is not satisfied: the brief lists two deliverables, PDF and JSON, but the delivery explicitly states: "JSON has not been delivered."
Clarity is satisfied: the delivery plainly identifies the PDF and its required string as delivered, identifies JSON as not delivered, and states that the deadline and budget were met.

sections.title: Acceptance criteria
sections.content:
- The deliverables consist of one PDF file and one JSON file for Acme.
- Both files contain the exact string "Ready to ship".
- The files are delivered by November 15.
- The work stays within the budget of 500 EUR.
